claims: NASA has launched the Artemis II mission.
Artemis II mission sends Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen on a journey.
Artemis II mission journey is 10 days.
Artemis II mission journey is 695,000 miles.
Artemis II mission journey is around the Moon and back.
Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
Reid Wiseman is Commander of Artemis II (NASA).
Victor Glover is Pilot of Artemis II (NASA).
Christina Koch is Mission Specialist of Artemis II (NASA).
Jeremy Hansen is Mission Specialist of Artemis II (Canadian Space Agency).
Artemis II mission features the first woman assigned to a lunar mission.
Artemis II mission features the first Black astronaut assigned to a lunar mission.
Jeremy Hansen is the first Canadian to fly to deep space.
Artemis II crew is testing the Integrity Orion spacecraft's life support systems.
Artemis II crew is conducting a flyby of the Moon before returning to Earth.
Artemis II mission prepares for Artemis III.
Artemis III is scheduled to land astronauts near the Moon’s south pole.
Current projections aim for Artemis III landing no earlier than 2027.
Artemis II crew is testing new, functional sanitation systems for long-term space travel.
Artemis II sanitation systems are an upgrade from the Apollo-era equipment.
